name: Doom 4 Vanilla: Scythe
comment: D4V v3.2.1 (gameplay) over Scythe episode 1 (Erik Alm). Load order as in D4V's readme: map WAD, D4V.wad, the MAP07 fix. Weapons: D4V's regular set plus four D4V 2.0+ extras as extra weapon slots (deh2c.py transplant, wp_extra*), each sharing a number key with its vanilla counterpart: H.A.R (4), Hellshot and Reaper (3), Gauss cannon (7) (the grenade launcher and lightning gun were dropped: broken / zone exhaustion on the device); their pickups replace some vanilla ones (place). dm_weapons: Scythe places the SSG, plasma rifle and BFG for deathmatch only; they appear in single player too. psprite_nudge lifts D4V's chainsaw, drawn mostly under the status bar. The Vortex rifle is left out: it depends on vanilla reading past the end of the weapon table (D4V: 'will not run on every port'), which crashes here. Stock walls and floors use the Dark Textures Pack - LowRes (Doomenator, low-res by L30W; JDoom layout, converted by tools/texture_pack.py, textures 128+ wide at half width); the rest falls back to Freedoom 0.13 patches (BSD). D4V's own art (doors, switches, liquids, sky) is kept.
